content: {"like":["Prefers cohesive, character‑driven stories with strong acting and period detail.","Values well‑designed sets, costumes, and atmospheric visuals.","Enjoys complex, eccentric plots with memorable, authentic characters.","Appreciates adaptations that stay true to source material and depth.","Likes films with strong comedic or artistic elements and thoughtful music."],"dislike":["Dislikes overcrowded casts and unresolved endings.","Avoids soap‑opera feel and shallow social themes.","Rejects miscasting and inaccurate character portrayals.","Dislikes flat storytelling and lack of depth.","Prefers not to have constant, unpleasant theme music."]}
